name: concept-learning
description: Research-first Java/Spring learning with topic-relevant sources and two modes: in-depth explanation or concise study summary.

interface.shortDescription: Explain concepts deeply or summarize the essentials, with relevant sources.
interface.longDescription: Research-first learning for early-career Java/Spring developers. Routes Explain to an in-depth lesson and Summarize to a concise, accurate study recap; uses relevant Korean developer, Tecoble and engineering articles. Textbook outlines are keyword discovery aids only when relevant to the requested topic; OOP books are not injected into unrelated Spring lessons. Finds genuinely useful images without filler, and checks source relevance, depth or brevity, accuracy and safety before responding.
capabilities: Explain backend mechanisms and tradeoffs in depth when asked to explain or start a lesson
Summarize core concepts and caveats concisely when asked to organize or recap a topic
Research only topic-relevant technical articles, books and instructional images before writing
